verdict.rationale: First-party docs show `sandbox.exec()` runs shell commands with captured stdout, stderr and exit codes. They also cover streaming output, background processes, and persistent bash sessions with their own env and cwd, all inside a full Linux container or VM where Docker and Git commands can run. Package installation is only implied by the full Linux environment and the preloaded pandas example. missing for 10: explicit documentation of installing packages (e.g. pip/npm/apt install) at runtime, independent or hands-on corroboration of shell and package workflows.
